variants.name: a_lea_mul_hoist_magic_bottom_loop
variants.note: BEATS gcc-10 -O2 by 12.7% (0.873x C)! In-place patch of $direct.unwind: (1) strength-reduce small-const imul (*3 -> lea (%r,%r,2), *5 -> lea (%r,%r,4)), (2) hoist loop-invariant division magic constants 0xaaaaaaab and 0xcccccccd out of the loop, (3) bottom-tested loop (sub $1; jne) + eliminate redundant test after sub and dead mov/push %rbx.

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (small-const imul->lea + div-magic LICM + bottom-tested loop: 2.19x -> 0.873x C, beats gcc-10 -O2)
probes.estimated_loc: ~95 LOC (~20 LOC imul->lea for *3/*5/*9, ~35 LOC loop-invariant imm/magic hoisting, ~40 LOC bottom-tested loop + redundant test elim)

variants.name: a_fill_magic_mod100
variants.note: Replaces 64-bit hardware `div %rcx` by 100 in $direct.fill with magic multiply (`imul $0x51eb851f; shr $37; imul $100`). Saves 214 ms (5.7% of total, and 26.2% of post-BFS runtime).

variants.name: b_bfs_unboxed_st_arrays
variants.note: MASSIVE WIN: $direct.bfs was 22.9 KiB (627 [rbp-] spills, 14 p111_rt_take + 14 p111_rt_ctor + 10 p113_rt_array_pair + 8 p111_rt_op calls) allocating/freeing St{g,q,d,head,tail} and Array.get Pair on every neighbour! Unboxing St into registers + hoisting g_dp/q_dp/d_dp out of the loop eliminates 72.6% of total runtime (3.65x speedup).

variants.name: ab_fill_plus_bfs_combined
variants.note: 4.94x speedup (9.21x C -> 1.86x C; eliminates >30s timeout at DEPTH=19 -> ~12s vs 6.4s C)! Remaining ~350 ms gap is $direct.maze heap-allocating/initializing/freeing 3x1024 64-bit arrays (24 KiB) per maze vs C stack uint32_t[1024] (12 KiB) + $direct.fold.

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (linear state-record unboxing + hoisted linear Array handles/pair-elim in loops: 3.65x; + general constant-divisor magic multiply for U32.div/mod: 4.94x total -> 1.86x C)
probes.estimated_loc: ~220 LOC (linear record unboxing + Array.get pair fusion / handle LICM in self-TCO loops); ~60 LOC (general u32 const div/mod magic multiply)

variants.name: a_lut_xmm_nearest
variants.note: Patched $direct.nearest + $direct.nearest.t: (1) replaced 4x 9-way if-else branch chains for sx/sy/sz/sr with static .rodata float LUTs (`movss tbl(,%rax,4), %xmm`), (2) kept 6 loop-invariant ray floats (ox,oy,oz,dx,dy,dz) in XMM registers instead of GPRs+6x movd/iter (caused by exit-only Hit p111_rt_ctor call!), (3) direct `ucomiss; jb` + `minss` + dead const-load DCE (folded fl(35,10) left dead 35.0f & 10.0f loads). Closes 96% of the gap -> 1.080x C (2.86x speedup)!

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (dense Nat-match -> .rodata float/int LUT + XMM loop-invariant pinning across exit-only calls + ucomiss branch fusion & dead float-const DCE: 2.86x -> 1.08x C)
probes.estimated_loc: ~180 LOC (~80 LOC dense match -> .rodata LUT, ~60 LOC XMM loop-invariant allocation ignoring cold/exit-only calls, ~40 LOC ucomiss branch fusion + dead const-load DCE)

variants.name: a_warp_ireuse_only
variants.note: Perceus in-place IReuse in $direct.warp ONLY: in Leaf/Leaf base case reuse both Leaf cells directly (0 Leaf free/alloc, branchless cmov swap, 1 Node pop); in Node/Node + warp_zip reuse wa, wb, and a in-place (0 Node allocs, only 1 free of b, 3 word writes) and drop redundant p111_program/p111_cid_hot hot-path checks. Alone delivers 3.30x speedup -> 1.141x C!

variants.name: ab_warp_plus_flow_ireuse
variants.note: DEAD HEAT WITH gcc-10 -O2 (1.001x C; 798.4 ms vs 806.0 ms on clean round 3)! Adding Perceus IReuse + base-case identity elision (`case 0n Node{wa,wb}: Node{wa,wb} -> w`, which previously freed & re-allocated w!) to $direct.flow eliminates 100% of remaining overhead.

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (Perceus in-place IReuse for matched unique CTORs + identity-arm elision + removing hot-path p111_program/p111_cid_hot checks: 3.76x -> 1.001x C)
probes.estimated_loc: ~220-250 LOC (Perceus IReuse token pairing in IR/codegen + identity match-rebuild elision + hoist/remove per-ICtor p111_program/p111_cid_hot tracing check)

variants.name: a_chunk_tco_loop
variants.note: BEATS gcc-10 -O2 by 9.9% (0.901x C; 294 ms vs 352 ms on clean rounds)! CRITICAL BUG/GAP FOUND: $direct.chunk has 34 params (29 stack-passed) so bend5k_o2 FAILED to self-TCO it, emitting `sub $0x648, %rsp` (1608-byte frame) + 29 stack pushes + `callq $direct.chunk` + 690 [rbp-] spills on EVERY SINGLE POINT! Lowering $direct.chunk to a self-TCO loop with compact stack accumulators delivers 4.26x speedup -> 0.901x C.

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (lift self-TCO arity cap to support >6 / stack-passed params in-place in the loop frame + branchless cmov argmin: 4.26x -> 0.901x C, beats gcc-10 -O2)
probes.estimated_loc: ~80 LOC (self-TCO with stack-passed params updating frame slots in-place instead of recursing); ~100 LOC (dense branchless accumulator update / spill reduction)
